items.t: Engine oil sludge (oil gel)
items.job: Remove oil pan and valve covers, clean out sludge, fresh oil
items.note: If the engine already knocks or has seized, a used or rebuilt engine is needed and costs much more.

items.t: Stripped cylinder head bolt threads
items.job: Remove head, install thread inserts, new head gasket and bolts
items.note: Cost rises a lot if overheating warped the head or damaged the engine.

items.t: Harsh or jerky automatic shifts
items.job: Reprogram transmission computer and check fluid
items.note: If the transmission is worn and the update does not help, a rebuild costs much more.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.note: Toyota's old ZE7 coverage has mostly ended; ask a dealer anyway. A used engine can cost less than a ring job.

items.t: Sticky, melting or cracked dashboard
items.note: Toyota's past dash program has likely ended. A fitted dash cover is a far cheaper fix for glare.

items.t: Driver's power window switch can overheat (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer first.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can be trapped by floor mat (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace accelerator pedal and fit correct mats
items.note: Done free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer.

items.t: VVT-i oil hose leak
items.job: Replace rubber VVT-i oil hose with updated metal line
items.note: Often free under a Toyota service campaign. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the engine ran low on oil.

items.t: Hybrid brake actuator or brake control unit failure
items.job: Replace hybrid brake actuator and bleed brakes
items.note: Toyota extended coverage on some cars. Check your VIN with a dealer. Used actuators cost less but carry risk.

items.t: Shudder at light throttle
items.job: Replace torque converter (after software update fails)
items.note: Try the dealer software update first; it is much cheaper and fixes some cars.

items.t: Water leak onto airbag control module (recall)
items.job: Replace airbag control module and seal the leak
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer.

items.t: Musty or moldy smell from the A/C
items.job: Clean A/C evaporator and replace cabin air filter
items.note: If the smell keeps coming back, replacing the evaporator costs much more.

items.t: Rough or hesitant shifting
items.note: Often free while under Toyota's powertrain warranty.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the fuel pump recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump failure (recall)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer.

items.t: Tail light bulb holder can lose contact (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 96V-037. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Key can be removed when not in Park (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 97V-213. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accelerator cable can wear through on V6 cruise control cars (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 01V-012. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear axle part may be weak from improper heat treatment (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 00V-154. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front subframe may be poorly welded (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 01V-072. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may be twisted (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace side curtain airbag
items.note: Free under recall 04V-346. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley outer ring can slip on V6 engines (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 11V-539. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wiper switch can short out (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 13V-505. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front lower control arm can separate from ball joint (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 14V-715. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel delivery pipe may leak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 14V-576. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
items.job: Replace electric power steering control unit
items.note: Free under recall 15V-144. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor miscalibrated (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-215. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger knee airbag attached with wrong fasteners (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-906. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Oversized pistons can cause stalling (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 18V-200. Check the VIN first.

items.t: V6 fuel pipes may not be fully connected (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel delivery pipes and hoses
items.note: Free under recall 18V-108. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine can leak coolant from porous castings (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-064. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor can short and disable the airbag (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-865. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wheel lug nuts may be loose (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect and torque wheel lug nuts, replace damaged studs
items.note: Free under recall 23V-432. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat head restraint brackets may be weakly welded (recall)
items.job: Replace rear seat back frame/head restraint brackets
items.note: Free under recall 24V-128. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid inverter bolt may be loose (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-869. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Instrument display can go blank after starting (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 26V-511. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leak
Knocking from worn front strut mounts and sway bar links
items.job: Replace front strut mounts and stabilizer bar links

items.t: Water pump leaks coolant
Alternator stops charging
Front oxygen sensor fails and lights the check engine light
Knocking or popping from the moonroof area
Squeak from the front stabilizer bar bushings
Check Brake System message at startup
items.job: Diagnose brake system codes, repair sensor or wiring

items.t: Automatic transmission fluid leak at the oil pan gasket
items.job: Reseal transmission oil pan and refill fluid

items.t: Hybrid battery cooling fan clogged with dust
items.job: Clean hybrid battery cooling fan and duct
items.note: Parts only if the fan itself is replaced; cleaning is labor.
